subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular `scripts/install.sh` architecture now, and must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact remain a preserved or generated single-file entrypoint?
rationale: The request is maintainability cleanup on a stable setup surface, while current docs, tests, release artifacts, and website sync assume one served installer script.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

options.title: Allow focused extractions only
options.body: Keep this as backlog guidance and extract installer sections only when tied to concrete bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep the installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent work on the installer file, release baseline, and GitHub-main install support.
